name: Chest Press Machine
instructions: Sit on the machine, grab the handles, and push forward until arms are extended.

name: Pectoral Machine
instructions: Sit on the machine, place arms on the pads, and bring them together in front of your chest.

name: Shoulder Press Machine
instructions: Sit on the machine, grab the handles above your shoulders, and press upwards.

name: Lat Pulldown Machine
instructions: Sit on the machine, grab the bar, and pull it down to your chest.

name: Rear Delt Machine
instructions: Sit facing the machine, grab the handles, and pull them backwards.

name: Row Machine
instructions: Sit on the machine, grab the handles, and pull them towards your chest.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit on the machine, place feet on the platform, and press the platform away.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Position yourself in the machine, lower your body by bending your knees, and press back up.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit on the machine, place legs under the pad, and extend your legs upwards.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lie or sit on the machine, and curl your legs towards your glutes.

name: Glute Machine
instructions: Use the machine pad to push your leg back and squeeze your glutes.

name: Adductor Machine
instructions: Sit on the machine and squeeze your legs together against the resistance.

name: Abductor Machine
instructions: Sit on the machine and push your legs apart against the resistance.

name: Calf Machine
instructions: Perform calf raises using the resistance of the machine.

name: Hip Thrust Machine
instructions: Place the belt/pad over your hips and thrust upward squeezing your glutes.

name: Core Machine
instructions: Use the machine to perform weighted crunches or rotational movements.

name: Cable Lat Pulldown
instructions: Use the high cable to pull the bar down to your chest.

name: Cable Row
instructions: Use the cable to pull the attachment towards your torso.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Use the cables from a high, medium, or low position to perform a fly motion.

name: Cable Lateral Raises
instructions: Use a low cable to raise your arm to the side.

name: Cable Biceps Extension
instructions: Use a low cable to perform a biceps curl.

name: Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Use a cable to extend your arms, isolating the triceps.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Attach a low cable to your ankle and kick your leg backwards.

name: Cable Core Crunch
instructions: Use a high cable with a rope attachment to perform kneeling crunches.

name: Barbell Horizontal Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and press the barbell upwards.

name: Dumbbell Horizontal Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and press the dumbbells upwards.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and press the barbell upwards.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and press the dumbbells upwards.

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on a bench and perform a fly motion with dumbbells.

name: Barbell Military Press
instructions: Stand or sit and press the barbell overhead.

name: Dumbbell Military Press
instructions: Stand or sit and press the dumbbells overhead.

name: Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at the hips and pull the barbell towards your torso.

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support yourself on a bench and pull the dumbbell towards your torso.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
instructions: Stand and raise the dumbbells to your sides.

name: Barbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand and curl the barbell upwards.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand and curl the dumbbells upwards.

name: Scott Bench Biceps Curl
instructions: Use a preacher bench (Scott bench) to perform biceps curls.

name: Barbell Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on a bench and extend the barbell upwards.

name: Dumbbell Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Lie on a bench and extend the dumbbells upwards.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Place the barbell on your shoulders, lower into a squat, and stand back up.

name: Kettlebell/Dumbbell Squat
instructions: Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell(s) at chest level and perform a squat.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Lift the barbell from the ground by extending your hips and knees.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Keep legs relatively straight and hinge at the hips to lower the barbell, then return to standing.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Keep legs relatively straight and hinge at the hips to lower the dumbbells, then return to standing.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench, place a barbell across your hips, and thrust upwards.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Elevate your rear foot on a bench, hold dumbbells, and perform a split squat.

name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Elevate your rear foot on a bench and perform a split squat using the Smith machine.

name: Pull-Ups
instructions: Use a prone, supine, or parallel grip to pull yourself up to the bar.

name: Parallel Bar Dips
instructions: Lower yourself between parallel bars and push back up.

name: Low Bar Push-Ups
instructions: Perform push-ups using a low bar for elevation.

name: Low Bar Australian Pull-Ups
instructions: Hang underneath a low bar with feet on the ground and pull your chest to the bar.

name: Ring Pull-Ups
instructions: Perform pull-ups using gymnastic rings.

name: Ring Dips
instructions: Perform dips using gymnastic rings for added instability.

name: Ring Push-Ups
instructions: Perform push-ups with your hands in gymnastic rings.

name: Ring Australian Pull-Ups
instructions: Hang underneath the rings with feet on the ground and pull your chest up.

name: Push-Ups
instructions: Perform standard push-ups on the ground.

name: Pike Push-Ups
instructions: Get into a pike position (hips high) and perform a push-up.

name: Handstand Push-Ups
instructions: Perform a push-up while in a handstand against a wall.

name: Superman
instructions: Lie face down and lift your arms and legs off the ground simultaneously.

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Perform a standard squat using only your bodyweight.

name: Jump Squat
instructions: Perform a squat and explode upwards into a jump.

name: Lunges
instructions: Step forward into a lunge and return to standing.

name: Jump Lunges
instructions: Perform a lunge and explosively jump, switching legs in the air.

name: Bodyweight Calf Raises
instructions: Stand on the ground or a step and raise your heels.

name: Plank
instructions: Hold a plank position on your forearms and toes.

name: Crunches
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, and curl your upper body towards your knees.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on one side propped on your forearm, lift the hips until the body is a straight line, and hold. Repeat on the other side.

name: Hollow Body Hold
instructions: Lie on your back, press the lower back into the floor, and lift the shoulders and legs a few inches off the ground. Hold.

name: Bird Dog Hold
instructions: On all fours, extend the opposite arm and leg until level with the torso and hold without letting the hips rotate.

name: Cable Pallof Press
instructions: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height, press the handle straight out, and resist the rotation. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Weighted Plank
instructions: Hold a forearm plank with a dumbbell resting on your upper back. Keep the hips level and the ribs tucked.

name: Hanging Leg Raises
instructions: Hang from the bar and raise straight legs to hip height or above, then lower under control without swinging.

name: Captains Chair Knee Raises
instructions: Support yourself on the parallel bars with the back straight and drive both knees up toward the chest.

name: Russian Twists
instructions: Sit with the heels off the floor and the torso leaned back, then rotate the shoulders side to side under control.

name: Bicycle Crunches
instructions: Lying on your back, bring the opposite elbow and knee together while extending the other leg. Alternate slowly.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back with arms and knees up, then lower one arm and the opposite leg while keeping the lower back flat.

name: Mountain Climbers
instructions: From a push-up position, drive the knees toward the chest one at a time at a steady pace with the hips low.

name: Cable Woodchopper
instructions: Pull the cable diagonally across the body from high to low, rotating through the trunk rather than the arms.

name: Back Extensions
instructions: Anchored on a bench or back-extension pad, hinge down and raise the torso until in line with the legs. Do not hyperextend.

name: Decline Sit-Ups
instructions: Hook your feet on a decline bench and curl the torso up, leading with the ribs rather than the neck.

name: Wall Sit
instructions: Slide down a wall until the knees are at 90 degrees and hold with the weight through the heels.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge at the hips and raise the dumbbells out to the sides with a soft elbow, squeezing the rear delts.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Raise the dumbbells straight in front of you to shoulder height, then lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
instructions: Curl the dumbbells with palms facing each other, keeping the elbows pinned to your sides.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
instructions: With elbows tucked, push the bar or rope down until the arms are locked out, then return slowly.

name: Bench Dips
instructions: Hands on a bench behind you, lower the hips until the elbows reach 90 degrees, then press back up.

name: Cable Face Pull
instructions: Pull a rope at face height toward your forehead, driving the elbows back and out to hit the rear delts.

name: Dumbbell Shrugs
instructions: Hold the dumbbells at your sides and shrug the shoulders straight up toward the ears. No rolling.

name: Band Chest Press
instructions: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and press both handles forward until the arms are extended.

name: Band Overhead Press
instructions: Stand on the band and press the handles overhead until the arms lock out.

name: Band Row
instructions: Anchor the band in front of you and row the handles to your ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades together.

name: Band Lat Pulldown
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and pull the handles down to your chest, driving the elbows toward the hips.

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold the band at shoulder height with straight arms and pull it apart until it touches your chest.

name: Band Biceps Curl
instructions: Stand on the band and curl the handles up with the elbows fixed at your sides.

name: Band Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Anchor the band high, tuck the elbows, and extend the arms down until locked out.

name: Band Squat
instructions: Stand on the band with the handles at your shoulders and squat to depth against the band tension.

name: Band Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand on the band, hinge at the hips with a flat back, and drive the hips forward to stand tall.

name: Banded Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with a band over the hips, drive through the heels and squeeze the glutes at the top.

name: Banded Lateral Walk
instructions: With a band around the knees or ankles, sit into a quarter squat and step sideways keeping tension on the band.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent, drive through the heels and lift the hips until the body is straight.

name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Perform a glute bridge with one foot on the floor and the other knee pulled to the chest. Keep the hips level.
